question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Have you ever been on a Homecoming Court?

nodes.text: Taylor stuffs ballots at an incredible clip.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This is probably enough to tip the scales my way!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: First of all, I'm going to Homecoming with Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks for everything, Jess. You're the best girlfriend ever!
Jessica leans over and whispers to Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And he's my fourth-favorite boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wow... I can't believe Jessica let me kiss her on the cheek! She moves pretty fast.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I `think` she bought me enough time to tip the scales in my favor!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]think[/i][/color] she bought me enough time to tip the scales in my favor!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks for helping me guard the ballots!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah... Right. I'd better get going. See you around!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sure thing, Taylor. Thanks for finding me a date.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh no, thank `you.` Helping others is its own reward.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh no, thank [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color] Helping others is its own reward.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You know what... I think a lot of people are wrong about you, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're not a sociopathic, soulless, conniving monster at all!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Pretend I didn't say all of that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure thing, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Hehe. What a sucker.
Taylor only stuffs in a few ballots.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I must be tired from waking up so early.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I hope I put in enough votes to swing things my way...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now to go switch the ballot boxes!
Taylor enters the room to find...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What the...?!
There's a brand-new, locked, titanium ballot box sitting in the middle of the room.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stupid Justin! I should have known that uptight loser would add additional security measures!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My plan to switch the boxes is ruined...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: There's no way to get any of the votes `out` of that box...
nodes.text_bbcode: There's no way to get any of the votes [color=#3b78e2][i]out[/i][/color] of that box...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But the slot at the top is open... I could still stuff some of my votes into it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I can only hope it's enough to make sure `my` candidates make it onto the court!
nodes.text_bbcode: I can only hope it's enough to make sure [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] candidates make it onto the court!

nodes.text: Taylor starts stuffing her votes into the box through the tiny slot. At this rate, she can only go one at a time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd better work fast... Who knows how long it will be before Justin comes back?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hang on a second... Would I have to touch him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Probably?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sigh... Well... Okay. I've done worse.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hey there, tiger. What do you say you and I go get acquainted under the bleachers?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't quite understand. What exactly could we discuss under the bleachers that we can't say right here?
Jessica leans over and whispers in Justin's ear.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'd better go get my toothbrush!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Taylor, would you mind guarding the ballot box while I'm gone?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gladly.
He runs off.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: At least he's decently groomed.
She walks off down the hall.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent! Justin's gone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `The School President!` Dating him would make you First Lady!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]The School President![/i][/color] Dating him would make you First Lady!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: This could very well put you on track to become the most popular girl at school once I leave for college!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Plus, think of the fringe benefits...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Insider knowledge about every dance... A guy who can sweet talk the principal and get you out of detention!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I guess he would have his... Uses.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: We're talking about the same Justin, right? Flabby McFlabberstein?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure the only time he's ever even `seen` the inside of a gym was that time he inspected the weight lifting equipment for safety violations!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure the only time he's ever even [color=#3b78e2][i]seen[/i][/color] the inside of a gym was that time he inspected the weight lifting equipment for safety violations!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So he's not exactly a body-builder. But I'm pretty sure he has nice... Uh... Calves?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Hm... I guess I've never seen him in shorts.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly! It's like I'm telling you, he's `hot!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! It's like I'm telling you, he's [color=#3b78e2][i]hot![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah? Well if he's so great, why don't `you` date him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah? Well if he's so great, why don't [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] date him?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay, okay. So he's a troll. But I `need` you to date him for... Certain reasons.
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, okay. So he's a troll. But I [color=#3b78e2][i]need[/i][/color] you to date him for... Certain reasons.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ha! The truth comes out. Okay, fine. I'll date the loser. But it's going to cost you.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Eighty bucks and the top spot on the pyramid.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How about fifty and I put you on the second row.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh oh... The price is going up. Now it's a hundred bucks and the top spot!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What! You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: One hundred and ten... One hundred and twenty... The price keeps going up...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine! It's a deal.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Nice doing business with you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Really? I thought she only dated college guys.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You're an `authority figure.` Jessica loves those!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? You're an [color=#3b78e2][i]authority figure.[/i][/color] Jessica loves those!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll go get her and be `right back.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll go get her and be [color=#3b78e2][i]right back.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Two minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Jessica! Come quick, I need you to date a boy for me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't know... I'm already dating three guys at Centerscore University.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So what's the harm in adding a fourth?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well... Who is he? How hot is he? What kind of car does he drive? Does he have access to a major credit card?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, he's not that cute... I think he drives a hatchback. And I've only ever seen him pay for things with dollar coins.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But he `is` the School President.
nodes.text_bbcode: But he [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] the School President.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Wait... You mean Justin? But he's so... Ick.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on, Jessica. Think of the bigger picture. Justin is...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Really? She `is` pretty cute...
nodes.text_bbcode: Really? She [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] pretty cute...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Excellent. I'll go fetch her and be right back...
Two minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Maria! Come quick, I need you to go to Homecoming with Justin!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: But... Jacob already asked me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! How is this possible?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We've been dating since last year... I thought you knew.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Fine. I'll get someone else. How about you, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'm going with Hector!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought he was going to dump you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Nope! We're more in love than ever!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Stupid... Love!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey Taylor... Uh, where's Maria?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The thing is... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Come on Taylor... Think!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wait! I think I have a solution... But it's `not` pretty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! I think I have a solution... But it's [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] pretty!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sweet Justin... How could I let her go to the dance with you when `I` want you myself?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sweet Justin... How could I let her go to the dance with you when [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want you myself?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You... You do?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah... Tons.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: In fact... If you want to go freshen up real quick... Maybe we could have our first kiss.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Lucky for you, I keep a toothbrush in my locker. I'll be right back.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You guard the ballot box while I'm gone.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Gladly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, at least he's gone... But I'm `definitely` not looking forward to that kiss.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, at least he's gone... But I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]definitely[/i][/color] not looking forward to that kiss.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: The prices women have to pay for crowns... Cleopatra probably had to do stuff like this.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least he's gone...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Yay! A plan!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Wait... What's your plan?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We held the primary vote yesterday... It decides the Princess nominees.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Later, the students will pick the Queen from the Final Four.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Usually, those nominees consist of me and three other popular girls. But not this time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As we speak, the votes are all sitting uncounted in a box at school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A box that looks `very much` like this one!
nodes.text_bbcode: A box that looks [color=#3b78e2][i]very much[/i][/color] like this one!

nodes.text: Taylor points to a bright red wooden box. It's filled with hundreds of paper slips.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's a near-perfect replica... Some of my best work.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll switch the boxes later today.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: You're switching the boxes? But why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why do I even try to explain things to you? Here, let me show you.
Taylor starts handing Elmo slips of paper from the box. He reads them aloud.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Taylor Vale... Taylor Vale...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Do these `all` have your name on them?
nodes.text_bbcode: Do these [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] have your name on them?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, `most` of them do.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]most[/i][/color] of them do.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But not all...
Taylor pulls out a paper with the name 'Sara Kessler' on it.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Who's Sara Kessler?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly. She's a nobody.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: And this one is Sa... Man...Tha... Who's 'Samantha'?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Another loser. She was cool for about ten minutes last year...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But ever since she and her mega-hot boyfriend Colt broke up, she's been pretty short-tempered...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It means she's been insulting and yelling at everyone, so her popularity meter is falling fast.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: She doesn't sound very nice. I don't think I'd vote for her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that makes her the perfect fake candidate...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's believable that she'd be elected... But there's no way she'd actually win.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I put in a few other losers' names too, just so that all the fake votes seem real. There's Denni, Jane, a few for Erik...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: These are all `fake votes?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: These are all [color=#e23b3b][i]fake votes?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I thought that was obvious...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: But that's... Cheating. And my teacher's always telling us not to do that in school...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I sometimes find it hard to believe that we're related.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: I just thought that you wouldn't need to cheat to win...

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Especially since you're the prettiest and most popular!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aw... Well, at least you're good for a little flattery now and then. Come here.
Taylor pulls Elmo in for a big hug.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry, dad. What I meant was... I can't believe you're making me run just a 10K!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That does seem a little short... And I suppose we are ready to ramp up your run for better endurance.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I wasn't going to suggest it yet, but if you're confident about progressing, I'm all for it!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Dad! That's perfect!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I'm glad you think so!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because while my dad thinks I'm off on my long run...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll `actually` be at the parade!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] be at the parade!

nodes.text: On Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's a 'Girl Wall'?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's when your friends form a wall around you with their bodies so that you can get changed!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... I guess I've never had friends to do that for me before.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, now you do.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So get changed!
A few minutes later...
Sara takes Hannah's skirt.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay! Let's form a Girl Wall so you can get changed!
Sara takes Linda's skirt.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Okay! Let's form a Girl Wall so you can get changed!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry, Dad. Saturday just won't work for me...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's just, uh... Aren't I supposed to relax my muscles on weekends?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Exactly! You'll be resting your `arms` while you work your legs!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! You'll be resting your [color=#e23b3b][i]arms[/i][/color] while you work your legs!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But... Uh... Maybe I could just do the jog on Friday? And rest `everything` on Saturday?
nodes.text_bbcode: But... Uh... Maybe I could just do the jog on Friday? And rest [color=#3b78e2][i]everything[/i][/color] on Saturday?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I guess `technically` that would work...
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess [color=#e23b3b][i]technically[/i][/color] that would work...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But that would definitely mean a long, long Friday workout.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You'd probably be tired the whole next day.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know...
On Saturday...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So... Sore... Can barely... Move!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Where do you think `you're` going?
nodes.text_bbcode: Where do you think [color=#e23b3b][i]you're[/i][/color] going?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... Out.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Out where?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: For... Uh... Another run?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I `do` admire your enthusiasm for jogging.
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] admire your enthusiasm for jogging.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Well, okay. Go forth! I'll make sure to adjust your calorie counter accordingly!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So... Sore... But at least now I can sneak out and go to the parade!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Any last words?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Probably not too many people think I'm going to win... But I'd love to prove them wrong!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Great quote, and I definitely like the underdog angle! Thanks for the help.
Denni runs off in search of other princesses.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Nice work! Now let's just hope you can do as well at the Homecoming Parade!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Any last words?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Overall, I guess I'm just pretty lame.
Denni scribbles furiously on her notepad.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wait! Don't write that down!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But I'm a reporter... The press has to publish the truth.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for the quotes!
Denni runs off in search of other princesses.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That didn't go well at all...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry! You can make up for it at the Homecoming Parade!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Homecoming Parade?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's the best!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah. You get to dress up all fancy and then get driven around town in a classic car while people cheer for you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Exactly. It's a little pageant-y.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: ...But there are worse ways to spend a Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I don't even have anything to wear.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't worry. `We'll` take care of that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't worry. [color=#3b78e2][i]We'll[/i][/color] take care of that!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh yes we will.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay... But, uh, I'm just not sure if my dad will let me go.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Your dad? That's easy. Just tell him you're going to the library, then make out with a hot guy you meet at a party!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Er... I guess that's just how `I` lie to my dad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Er... I guess that's just how [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] lie to my dad.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: She makes a decent point though. Sometimes you need a lie or two to get you through the day.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I `never` lie to my dad...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] lie to my dad...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sweetie, you've never been a Homecoming Princess before either...
That night at home...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: More chicken, please...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Not a chance!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I spent all of yesterday calculating your precise caloric intake for this week!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: And that chicken `definitely` isn't part of the plan.
nodes.text_bbcode: And that chicken [color=#e23b3b][i]definitely[/i][/color] isn't part of the plan.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm hungry...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That's just the feeling of your body getting stronger.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's too bad Mom took Emily on that school camping trip... `She'd` sneak me some extra food later tonight.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's too bad Mom took Emily on that school camping trip... [color=#3b78e2][i]She'd[/i][/color] sneak me some extra food later tonight.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Here's the even better news... I've got the rest of your training regimen all planned!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: In addition to your daily swim, you've got weight-lifting on Tuesday and Friday...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Plus a 10K run on Saturday.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It should be the perfect time for a jog!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Apparently, a lot of the streets will be closed for a silly Homecoming Parade.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Can you believe some girls your age actually care about that kind of thing?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You want me to run on Saturday? But I can't!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What do you mean you 'can't'? Do you have something else planned I'm not aware of?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! I can't tell my dad about the parade! But I've never lied to him before...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I'll just tell him a great lie! I have to act cool, seem natural...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Everyone knows I'm a swimmer, and that I try to work really hard at it.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's because I'm determined to do well in all areas of my life.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And that determination is what is going to allow me to succeed at my dream of being an Olympic swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't think many of our peers are so devoted. It's kind of inspiring that you're already dreaming so big.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, uh, thanks!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if that's a word, but I'm guessing you're talking about your perfectionism.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd like for everything to happen in a specific way and for everything to follow a specific plan.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know some people say perfectionism isn't realistic, but I think it's what you should strive for.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something that isn't real?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wish this interview was over already...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if that's a word, but I'm guessing you're talking about your perfectionism.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd like for everything to happen in a specific way and for everything to follow a specific plan.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know some people say perfectionism isn't realistic, but I think it's what you should strive for.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something that isn't real?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wish this interview was over already...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, uh... Perfectionistic?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I don't know if that's a word, but I'm guessing you're talking about your perfectionism.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I'd like for everything to happen in a specific way and for everything to follow a specific plan.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know some people say perfectionism isn't realistic, but I think it's what you should strive for.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Something that isn't real?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wish this interview was over already...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And what's one last word you'd use to describe yourself?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I am most definitely...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't want to be like other girls. I know I'm different, and I'm proud of it.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You mean we won't find you obsessing about becoming Homecoming Queen?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I do love to win. But I'm not going to pretend it defines who I am.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I just mean that I don't like things that other girls really like.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like a social life?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um, yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why'd I say that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I just mean that I don't like things that other girls really like.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like a social life?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um, yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why'd I say that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, uh... Unpopular?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I just mean that I don't like things that other girls really like.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Like a social life?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Um, yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why'd I say that?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: What else?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm also...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I keep to myself. Like a loner.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That didn't come out right.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's interesting... Why do you say that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, I'm not one of those girls who posts her whole life up for the world to see. I like to keep things to myself.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: A girl should always have some secrets after all.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That does keep the press wanting more.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I keep to myself. Like a loner.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That didn't come out right.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, I don't know... Isolated?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I keep to myself. Like a loner.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That didn't come out right.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't pay attention to her, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Who cares if she rigged the voting? You're a princess now.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And if you do things right, maybe you can be Queen!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do you mean 'do things right'? What do Homecoming Princesses have to do?
Suddenly, Denni pops up out of nowhere!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, for a start, you have to answer some questions for the school paper!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Questions?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Let's start with a softball. Give me some adjectives that describe you!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Er... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What do I say? I don't want to be boring... But everything I do is related to swimming, and everything I'm known for is swimming!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What should I say to make myself look good?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I would say that I'm...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... So what? Everyone likes winning. Duh.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm just saying... Maybe I won't be as easy to beat as you think.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No... Trust me. You will.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But, `maybe` I won't.
nodes.text_bbcode: But, [color=#3b78e2][i]maybe[/i][/color] I won't.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I really don't have time for this. I've got to go intimidate the other girls.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ta-ta!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I haven't lost a swim race since I was four.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: In fact, I can't remember the last time I lost `anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, I can't remember the last time I lost [color=#3b78e2][i]anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I'm not planning to start now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: But you... You're a loser! You don't even care about popularity!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I never did care... Until it became a competition.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well then, game on, Sara. Maybe it's time you finally taste defeat.
Taylor turns and struts off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope I can still make Homecoming Queen! If I'm going to do it for Howard, I must win!
Let's rewind things to the moment Sara found out about her nomination!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...And next, we've got Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Huh? Did someone say my name?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't look now, but I think you just got chosen to be a Homecoming Princess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Homecoming Princesses are one of the last vestiges of a patriarchal society that has oppressed women for generations!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! How terrible.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Er... Sorry. I didn't mean to make you feel bad.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't listen to Sourpants McFeminist over there, Sara. This is a good thing!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's true, Sara. This nomination means people `like` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's true, Sara. This nomination means people [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: They do?
Overhearing Sara, Taylor finishes talking to Justin and walks over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just FYI, `normally` getting a nomination means you're popular...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just FYI, [color=#3b78e2][i]normally[/i][/color] getting a nomination means you're popular...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this time, you only got nominated because I rigged the vote.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And why are you telling us?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I got you a nomination because I know you can't beat me, silly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm telling you because I don't want you to get your hopes up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd hate to see your little heart break when you find out you're not Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See? When you make faces like that, you look even uglier.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Taylor, there's something you should know about me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When it comes to competitions...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You know, I always thought it was a little hypocritical for people to brag about their modesty.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Aren't you just contradicting yourself?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. Right. Good point.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I mean, it's great that you're modest. Just don't be too afraid to show yourself off for the campaign...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, next question. How would you describe your personality in three words or less?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I wouldn't.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know, the modesty thing.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, okay...
The rest of the interview passes...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Well, thanks for the interview, $ZOE. I'll be sure to run what I know about you tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, thank you.
$ZOE walks out of the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Your kindness?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. A lot of people say that I have a kind heart, and I take that as a compliment.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I always feel there's never a reason to be mean to anyone, and that everyone should be given a basic level of respect and decency.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I really like that answer...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Tell me more about yourself. What are the things you like to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I like what many teenage girls like... Relaxing on the weekends, hanging out with friends, kissing my boyfriend...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hee hee.
The rest of the interview passes until at last...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Thanks for the interview! It was really nice getting to know you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, sure thing!
$ZOE walks out of the classroom.
An hour later, Howard comes back.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where are your parents?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, they're out on their date now. They just had a flat tire, so I fixed it for them. How'd everything go here?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, twins. I'm going to take care of Kara. I'm trusting you two with the very important task of yelling when the cupcakes are done, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You can trust me.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You can trust `us.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You can trust [color=#3b78e2][i]us.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE goes in to check on baby Kara. She holds the baby to stop her from crying, but Kara won't stop!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: `Wahhhhhh!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Wahhhhhh!!![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if I ever wanted children, this is enough to make me think twice!
Five minutes goes by... Then ten... $ZOE keeps rocking the baby until at last Kara quiets down.

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Coo....

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew, glad that's done with, but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, the cupcakes!
$ZOE runs back into the kitchen! The twins are eating the batter out of the bowl, while the cupcakes burn in the oven!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Oh no! We forgot all about them!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Is that what the burny smell was?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Kel! If you hadn't been so busy putting your face in the icing, we would've noticed!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What about you? You were also eating out of the bowl!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Twins!` Stop!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Twins![/i][/color] Stop!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Uh-oh. Are we in trouble?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Yes.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yes.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right, twins. I have a very special job for you to do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: In fact, I'm not sure if I should even trust you with this task. Do you think you're old enough to do it?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're older now!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We're 18 if you count both of us together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's great! Well, I'm going to need you two to be good big sisters and go check on Kara really quickly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's crying, and I just want you to talk to her a little bit.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Can you do that for me?
While the twins scamper off, $ZOE watches her cupcakes. A few minutes later, they come out of the oven.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whew! I'm glad those are out, but... I haven't heard anything on the baby monitor...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, the baby... Kay? Kel?
$ZOE runs into the nursery... And finds baby Kara laughing happily in her crib as the twins make faces and funny sounds at her!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: What about this one? Bwab bwab bwab!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: She's already a much faster learner than Howard! We like her better. We're going to teach her everything!

nodes.speaker: Baby Kara
nodes.text: Ba ba ba!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm so happy to hear that. And just for being so responsible... You girls want to test the cupcakes?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay!
Taylor walks off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I won't let Taylor get to me. I'm going to win! I need to protect Howard!
After school, Howard comes up to $ZOE and kisses her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just a congratulations on becoming Homecoming Princess.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You deserve it. You're one of the kindest, most loveable girls I know.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And you'll make a great Homecoming Queen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I intend to win!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, you have a great shot. There's a reason why you were up there today, and it's not just because you're popular.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Aww, Howard, you're so sweet!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I try. Anyway, I have to run to football practice, but I just wanted to wish you luck.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let me know if you need help with baking all those cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Baking? Cupcakes? What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your cupcakes? You know, the ones you're going to bake for the entire school? Everyone's really excited about them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never said I was going to make cupcakes... Who's been telling everyone this?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, there's a poster in the hallway. I assumed you made it...
$ZOE storms around the corner and sees a gigantic poster of a cupcake next to her own face.
The poster reads, 'Sweets from the sweetest candidate! Tomorrow at lunch, I'm bringing cupcakes for the entire school!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I never posted this. I think Taylor is behind this. In fact, I `know` she is.
nodes.text_bbcode: I never posted this. I think Taylor is behind this. In fact, I [color=#3b78e2][i]know[/i][/color] she is.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: When I don't show up tomorrow with cupcakes, the entire school is going to be disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's devious.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you know what? I'm not going to let Taylor get away with this. I'm going to bake cupcakes for everyone just to prove to her that I can win.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Have fun at practice, Howard. I have something to take care of.
$ZOE rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so glad the store had enough ingredients for a couple hundred cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But how am I ever going to make that many? Maybe I can get Sam's help!
$ZOE goes up to Sam's room.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're home! I was wondering if you would help me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. With what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm making cupcakes for my Homecoming Queen campaign, and I need some help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If anyone's going to take down Taylor, I'm going to be the one to do it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, you're not the only one who's a Homecoming Princess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, of course I'm not. I didn't mean it like that. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really want to be Queen, and... I just didn't think you were really in the running.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that! I meant...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, save it. You don't think I'll win. It's because I mean, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, not at all! It just doesn't seem like something you would like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. I shouldn't have asked you. I'm just going to work on the cupcakes on my own. Don't worry about it.
$ZOE leaves Sam and runs downstairs.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, I didn't mean to insult Sam.
$ZOE calls up Howard and tells him about her run-in with Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And then I accidentally made it sound like she doesn't have a shot at winning. I feel awful.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm sure it's not that bad. But I'm guessing you probably don't want to be in your house right now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, listen, why don't you come over here, and I'll make you some posters while you bake cupcakes. My parents are gone for the evening...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, thanks so much! I just need a nice, quiet place to work. This is perfect!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be over in twenty minutes! `Be prepared to bake!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be over in twenty minutes! [color=#3b78e2][i]Be prepared to bake![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, I should probably tell you that...
The line goes dead.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Huh. I guess she'll find out soon enough.
Twenty minutes later, $ZOE rings Howard's doorbell. The door opens, and $ZOE bursts in.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, I have everything we need. The flour, the frosting, the cupcake liners...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Yay! That sounds like cupcakes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Kel? Kay?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: I totally told Kel that you weren't lying when you said you'd bring us cupcakes!
Howard comes to the door, carrying baby Kara in his arms.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: My parents are out, and I'm baby-sitting my sisters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh-oh... I don't know if I can bake and take care of them at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But don't worry, it'll be fine. I can help with posters and stuff, while you have free reign of the kitchen.
$ZOE puts all her supplies in the kitchen and works in blissful silence until Howard calls from the living room.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, uh, $ZOE? My parents are having car trouble. I have to go pick them up. Would you mind watching the twins and the baby for a little bit?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can watch the baby, but can't the twins go with you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ever since the triple U-turn incident, they're not allowed in cars unless they're going to school.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course I'll take care of them. Go make sure your parents are okay. Don't worry.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks! Call if you need anything, but I'll be back as soon as I can. Oh, and by the way the posters are done.
Howard leaves, and $ZOE looks over her posters.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Imagine a school where the most popular girl is also the nicest!' Hah, I like it a lot.
Suddenly, a loud noise from the baby monitor echoes through the kitchen!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I leave the cupcakes now, they're going to burn... But who else is going to take care of the baby?
Kay and Kel look from the baby monitor to $ZOE.

options.label: Ask the twins to check on the baby.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because from now on, you'll be competing against me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So there is something that will get you all upset and huffy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm not afraid of you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got voted into the court, which means I have a chance.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Think whatever you want. If you'll excuse me, I'm going to be making my campaign posters.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better watch your back, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I already do.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, if that's the best you can come up with, this race is going to be easy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you'll excuse me, this Princess has some campaign posters to make.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You'd better watch your back, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Consider yourself, uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, if that's the kind of quick thinking I can expect from you in this race, this is going to be easy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now, while you take the next five minutes to come up with something that's vaguely insulting, I'm going to be making campaign posters.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, what I'm trying to say here is I'm mean, and I'm kind of sorry about that, but I'm also kind of not.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sometimes, I think it's okay to be mean, especially to the people who deserve it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like Taylor for instance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So if you're all for me standing up to Taylor and to other people who treat you badly, then vote for me!
The students in the audience clap for Sam as she steps back into line.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, what I'm trying to say here is you should vote for me because I'm really nice deep down!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And if you vote for me, I'd be really nice up front. I'd totally change.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And after that I would just continue to be a nice person. Period. Ever. `Forever,` in fact.
nodes.text_bbcode: And after that I would just continue to be a nice person. Period. Ever. [color=#3b78e2][i]Forever,[/i][/color] in fact.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, thanks?
Everyone in the audience stares at Sam blankly as Sam steps back into line.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And thank you, Sam... For that long speech.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I hope that speech was enough to make me look good.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know I can be Homecoming Queen!
Rewinding to the day the nominations were announced...
At lunch...
$ZOE finds Amanda, Maria, and Jessica at her locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you girls doing here? We don't have lunch practice today, do we?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No... We just came to congratulate you on making it to the Homecoming Court! Good luck with your campaign. I hope you win.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, you'd make a really great queen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I get nominated.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you'd better if you don't want Taylor to make out with Howard at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Didn't you know? The Homecoming King and Queen always share a kiss during their dance once the King's been announced.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? That doesn't mean Howard is going to be King. Or that Taylor is going to kiss him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're so naive. Howard is definitely going to be Homecoming King.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, all the girls were talking about voting for him in the bathroom after the announcements.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, there's no one like Howard. He's hot, popular, and one of the best players on the football team. He's sure to win.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if he does and you don't, then Howard and Taylor are going to go on that tropical vacation together... Alone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wouldn't be surprised if Taylor makes a move on him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I won't give her the chance! I'm definitely going to win Homecoming Queen now.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'll be rooting for you.
The cheerleaders walk away, and $ZOE turns back to her locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not letting anyone else kiss Howard. I have to win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good luck trying. I'm after the crown this year, and I'll do anything to get it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know what you did to get yourself nominated, but you can't compete with me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Someone shy like you won't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not true.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's the best thing about yourself?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's, uh... I'm, uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly. Who's going to vote for someone who can't even figure out why she deserves to win?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be crowned Queen, kiss Howard, and go on a dream vacation with him. While you dance with the commoners.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one is kissing Howard but me, Taylor. Consider yourself...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: If this was a competition about being nice, we'd all vote for $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She does have a point.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've been mean to people, but there have been good reasons why.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Come on, `anyone` who's run into Taylor knows that she can be mean about `nothing at all!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] who's run into Taylor knows that she can be mean about [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing at all![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Because... Well, it's hard to say.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Let me ask you this, why `shouldn't` you vote for me over Taylor? Ever thought about it that way?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Sure, but that doesn't mean anyone should vote for you over me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You should vote for me because...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think I was very good at it, but I managed to help people get dates.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And mostly everyone was happy with how that turned out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Like you, Megan...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And Linda, I hope you don't forget the advice I gave you...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Of course not! You completely changed my life!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So, as you can see, I help people in a lot of ways. So I'm not 100% mean.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I made sure everyone was happy, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because that's what cheerleaders do... `Cheer` people up.
nodes.text_bbcode: Because that's what cheerleaders do... [color=#3b78e2][i]Cheer[/i][/color] people up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I wasn't that mean then, was I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Like when I was a, uh, helper. Of people.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, I can't have been mean `all` the time. Surely, I was nice to at least one person.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The reason you should get behind me as Homecoming Queen is because, when I'm not insulting people, I help them. Like when I was a...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm, uh, I'm Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm really glad that everyone is here today. And isn't it really nice outside?
There is no answer from the students in the stands.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I really have to remember that $ZOE is better at this crap than I am.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: All right, everyone... So I know that a lot of people here have no reason to vote for me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Because I haven't exactly been the nicest person in the world, but...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... I, uh... Well...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. At least people still want to hang out with me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now that you're on the swim team, no one cares who you are.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And that means you're going to lose the race for Homecoming Queen... `Especially` since you can't be nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: And that means you're going to lose the race for Homecoming Queen... [color=#3b78e2][i]Especially[/i][/color] since you can't be nice.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Don't blow it, Sam.
Taylor saunters off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I can't let Taylor get under my skin. I don't care about becoming Homecoming Queen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what if everybody thinks I'm mean?!
Later that evening, Sam has just flopped on her bed when $ZOE comes in!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, you're home! I was wondering if you would help me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. With what?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm making cupcakes for my Homecoming Queen campaign, and I need some help.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If anyone's going to take down Taylor, I'm going to be the one to do it!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know, you're not the only one who's a Homecoming Princess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Sam, of course I'm not. I didn't mean it like that. It's just...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I really want to be Queen, and... I just didn't think you were really in the running.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, $ZOE, ouch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't mean it like that! I meant...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, save it. You don't think I'll win. It's because I mean, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, not at all! It just doesn't seem like something you would like.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Sam. I shouldn't have asked you. I'm just going to work on the cupcakes on my own. Don't worry about it.
$ZOE leaves, and Sam flops back on her bed.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great, I just yelled at the one person who actually likes me... Maybe I really am mean...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No wonder no one thinks I can win this...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I can change! I'll show them!
The next morning at school, Sam tries to be nice to people!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Vote for me for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Or else what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: There's no 'or else'! I just want you to vote for me!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Eep!
Angie runs away. Sam sighs.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, so maybe greeting people cold isn't going to do it for me. There must be other ways to prove that I am nice without having to make small talk...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! There you are!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you want, nerd-face?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I hope you don't address the people who vote for you like that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry. What's up?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm letting all the candidates know about the speech they have to give at the end of today in the gym.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's just a couple lines about why people should vote for you. The school newspaper is going to cover the event, so uh...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Try to be personable.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I'll show you personable!
At the end of the school day...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: As your student body President, I'm happy to announce the Homecoming Princesses!
Everyone in the crowd cheers!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And here's Sara!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Who's that again?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Is she, like, a transfer?
Sara steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... I'm Sara. I'm on the swim team since swimming is my favorite sport.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm the kind of girl that hates to lose, so I'm going to do my best to win! So, yeah, thanks for the opportunity to be Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I won't let you down!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All right. Next is $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go $ZOE! Woo!
$ZOE steps up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, I'm $ZOE. I'm on the cheerleading squad, and I'd be really honored if everyone voted for me!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thank you!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And next is Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm Taylor, the head cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE may be sweet, Sam may be mean, and Sara may be... Something, but I'm pretty, popular, and awesome, so vote for me for Homecoming Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm the best because I am!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor is ridiculous... I'd better speak out.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Like I haven't heard that one before... But next up is Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I don't have the best luck with being nice, but I don't think I'll win if I'm more direct...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Should I pretend to be $ZOE and be nice? Or is it better to be direct and admit I'm mean?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Upfront? Really? You're going to go with that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: People appreciate someone who's upfront more than someone who's fake.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Which is more than I can say for you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're just popular because everyone's scared of you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! No wonder no one wants to vote for you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Trust me when I say no one else thinks you're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not like you're all that either, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No way, I'm letting her get to be on the court! I'm staying on!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All right. That makes my life easier. Good luck.
Sam turns away from Justin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just can't believe I was popular enough to become a Homecoming Princess.
A shadow falls across Sam, and she looks up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And a `princess` is all you'll ever be! Don't let it go to your head. Besides, no one really voted for you anyway.
nodes.text_bbcode: And a [color=#3b78e2][i]princess[/i][/color] is all you'll ever be! Don't let it go to your head. Besides, no one really voted for you anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I fixed the vote.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Yeah, I can. And did.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And what if I tell Justin all about it?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You're really going to complain to him about being a Princess? Denni would take your place.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Besides, you'd look just as bad.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because I stuffed the box with your name too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I wanted to win. And 60% of the student body said that you were least likely to become Homecoming Queen.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?
Taylor pulls a paper from her bag. On it is a printed list of numbers. Sam grabs it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Give me that! '60% of the student body think Sam is least likely to win because she is mean'.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is crap. I'm not mean, I'm just...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She was the one that my boyfriend cheated on me with!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is unfortunate... And I'm sure I should be mildly sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But that doesn't change the fact she's still next in line for your crown.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh! Forget this!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Denni? A liar? I've never seen anything to support that claim.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Besides, she's a journalist. She writes quality work for the newspaper!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And even if she is a liar, I can respect that kind of ambition if you use it to get to the top.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, forget this!
We'll leave Taylor to her scheming for now...
It's time for `you` to get to know our Homecoming Princess candidates a little better!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's time for [b]you[/b] to get to know our Homecoming Princess candidates a little better!

nodes.text: ...By playing as each of them!
So let's see here... We've got $ZOE the sweet One, Sam the Cranky One, and Sara the Longshot.
Who do you want to play as first?
Rewinding to the day the nominations were announced...
Sam walks up to Justin after the announcement.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think there's been a mistake. Are you sure I'm a Homecoming Princess?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's no mistake! I can assure you that the ballots have not been tampered with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I didn't even run...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Unlike the Presidency, you don't 'run' for Princess, you get nominated.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't want to make a speech, or wear a fancy dress, or parade around in... Well, the parade.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't even think I have a date I can go with.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, if you would like to drop out, I can inform the fifth-place candidate if you want...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure she'd appreciate it more than I would.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll be sure to let Denni know that she's replacing you then.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... `Denni` is the runner-up for Princess?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa... [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni[/i][/color] is the runner-up for Princess?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah... Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Denni is...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Samantha has proven to be a most confusing Homecoming Princess.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Her assurances to the public that she is 'actually very nice' and 'has changed for the better' gave way to a deafening and unimpressed silence.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Initial poll results showed 60% of the student body believed she had no chance of becoming Queen. That percentage has since increased...'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: '$ZOE promises to be the least interesting of the Homecoming Court.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: '$ZOE claims her most outstanding quality is that she is modest, a trait that didn't allow this reporter to gain any real information about her...'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'Except about how modest she absolutely can be.'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: 'One strike against her is her abominable sense of fashion...'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: 'As she showed at the Homecoming Parade, Sara is trying `way` too hard.'
nodes.text_bbcode: 'As she showed at the Homecoming Parade, Sara is trying [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too hard.'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: 'A virtually unknown candidate, Sara proved to be just as boring and strange in person as rumors initially suggested.'
Just then, Justin walks into the room!
At lunch...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Attention, attention! I have a couple of announcements to make!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Second, I'm up here to tell you the results of the votes for our Homecoming Court!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now remember... This year, not only will the four lovely ladies I call up get the chance to be crowned Queen of the Homecoming Dance...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But the nominated Queen will also win a complimentary vacation to a tropical hotspot with her King!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That trip is mine!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And now for the moment you've all been waiting for... The announcement of the Homecoming Princesses!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good luck on your run! Try not to take more than an hour!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh... Sure...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That doesn't give me much time...
Sara runs down the street toward the parade, where she bumps into Linda and Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: There you are! You'd better get changed quick, the parade is about to start!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Your top looks fine, but you should try on one of my skirts!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't you `dare` borrow a skirt from her!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you [color=#3b78e2][i]dare[/i][/color] borrow a skirt from her!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: She managed to lose two of the cutest guys at school... She's obviously fashion-defective.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `I`, on the other hand, am willing to lend you the hottest miniskirt I own!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color], on the other hand, am willing to lend you the hottest miniskirt I own!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's gotten me sent home for a dress-code violation... Twice!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't confuse 'hot' with 'trashy'.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whose skirt do I borrow?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And this year, it's my turn to win! They're making the prize for Homecoming Queen even better...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: They're sending the Homecoming King and Queen on a vacation to the tropics! It's what I deserve, Elmo.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Then I'm sure you'll win, Sis!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh, so am I, dear brother... So am I.

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Uh... Why are you so sure?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Because I have...
Later that day...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin! What a coincidence! How nice to run into you.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: 'Coincidence' huh? I'm thinking this is no accident.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Why, Justin! Whatever do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What I mean is, I'm here guarding the door to Room 223, which just so happens to contain the `Homecoming Ballot Box!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What I mean is, I'm here guarding the door to Room 223, which just so happens to contain the [color=#e23b3b][i]Homecoming Ballot Box![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Which means that `every popular girl at school` has already tried to break in and take a sneak peek at the votes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Which means that [color=#e23b3b][i]every popular girl at school[/i][/color] has already tried to break in and take a sneak peek at the votes.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Justin! I'm offended that you'd think so little of me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Actually, I'm here because... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I want to set you up on a date! You need one for Homecoming, right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A... Date? Like... With... A girl?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh... Yes! I'm just about to go get her. She's... Shy.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shoot! I really should have thought this out better. I don't even have a girl in mind!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So who is this mystery girl?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's...
Rewinding to the day the nominations were announced...
Sam walks up to Justin after the announcement.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I think there's been a mistake. Are you sure I'm a Homecoming Princess?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's no mistake! I can assure you that the ballots have not been tampered with.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I didn't even run...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Unlike the Presidency, you don't 'run' for Princess, you get nominated.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I don't want to make a speech, or wear a fancy dress, or parade around in... Well, the parade.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't even think I have a date I can go with.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, if you would like to drop out, I can inform the fifth-place candidate if you want...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sure she'd appreciate it more than I would.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll be sure to let Denni know that she's replacing you then.

nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa... `Denni` is the runner-up for Princess?
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, whoa, whoa... [color=#3b78e2][i]Denni[/i][/color] is the runner-up for Princess?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah... Is that a problem?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But Denni is...
Rewinding to the day the nominations were announced...
At lunch...
$ZOE finds Amanda, Maria, and Jessica at her locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you girls doing here? We don't have lunch practice today, do we?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: No... We just came to congratulate you on making it to the Homecoming Court! Good luck with your campaign. I hope you win.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, you'd make a really great queen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If I get nominated.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you'd better if you don't want Taylor to make out with Howard at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Didn't you know? The Homecoming King and Queen always share a kiss during their dance once the King's been announced.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? That doesn't mean Howard is going to be King. Or that Taylor is going to kiss him.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're so naive. Howard is definitely going to be Homecoming King.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, all the girls were talking about voting for him in the bathroom after the announcements.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Besides, there's no one like Howard. He's hot, popular, and one of the best players on the football team. He's sure to win.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: And if he does and you don't, then Howard and Taylor are going to go on that tropical vacation together... Alone.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I wouldn't be surprised if Taylor makes a move on him.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, I won't give her the chance! I'm definitely going to win Homecoming Queen now.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We'll be rooting for you.
The cheerleaders walk away, and $ZOE turns back to her locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not letting anyone else kiss Howard. I have to win!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Is that so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Good luck trying. I'm after the crown this year, and I'll do anything to get it.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't know what you did to get yourself nominated, but you can't compete with me!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Someone shy like you won't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's not true.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah? What's the best thing about yourself?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's, uh... I'm, uh...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Exactly. Who's going to vote for someone who can't even figure out why she deserves to win?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be crowned Queen, kiss Howard, and go on a dream vacation with him. While you dance with the commoners.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No one is kissing Howard but me, Taylor. Consider yourself...
Let's rewind things to the moment Sara found out about her nomination!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...And next, we've got Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Huh? Did someone say my name?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Don't look now, but I think you just got chosen to be a Homecoming Princess!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Homecoming Princesses are one of the last vestiges of a patriarchal society that has oppressed women for generations!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh no! How terrible.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Er... Sorry. I didn't mean to make you feel bad.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't listen to Sourpants McFeminist over there, Sara. This is a good thing!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's true, Sara. This nomination means people `like` you!
nodes.text_bbcode: It's true, Sara. This nomination means people [color=#3b78e2][i]like[/i][/color] you!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: They do?
Overhearing Sara, Taylor finishes talking to Justin and walks over.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Just FYI, `normally` getting a nomination means you're popular...
nodes.text_bbcode: Just FYI, [color=#3b78e2][i]normally[/i][/color] getting a nomination means you're popular...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Unfortunately, this time, you only got nominated because I rigged the vote.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why would you do that?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And why are you telling us?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I got you a nomination because I know you can't beat me, silly.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And I'm telling you because I don't want you to get your hopes up!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'd hate to see your little heart break when you find out you're not Queen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: See? When you make faces like that, you look even uglier.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Taylor, there's something you should know about me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: When it comes to competitions...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Our first lovely lady is... Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh oh. That wasn't part of the plan... Did I not stuff enough votes?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And next up we have... Jane!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: While my inner-feminist rages at this sexist competition... It's still nice to be chosen!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That... That doesn't even make sense? Who would have voted for her?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And then we have... Erik! Never underestimate the power of the 'joke vote'!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hooray!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And finally we have... Angie!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Really? Maybe people are finally starting to appreciate my thoroughness and attention to detail!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: These... These choices don't make sense at all!

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: That's because cheaters never prosper!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Elmo? What are `you` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Elmo? What are [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.speaker: Elmo
nodes.text: Well, after you rigged the vote... I re-rigged it!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I was wondering why all the entries were written in crayon...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And Taylor... You rigged the vote?!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... Uh... The thing is...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I always knew she was a liar! How can we be sure she didn't win her other crowns by cheating too?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: She has a point, Taylor...
And so, a little later...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll be taking this... And this!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! You can't take away my precious tiaras... `My precious!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No! You can't take away my precious tiaras... [color=#3b78e2][i]My precious![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Uh oh... It looks like Taylor won't be winning that Triple Crown anytime soon.
You might want to start over from the beginning and try again...

Try again!

nodes.text: Seriously? We give you a second chance and you just go `right` back and do the `same` thing!

nodes.speaker: Justin

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Er... Uh... The thing is...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I... I think I'm going to be sick.

'This reporter was able to snag one of these sweet treats despite their popularity, but not before getting the inside scoop on this candidate...'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: '$ZOE is certainly one of the sweetest and most refreshing Princesses in the Homecoming Court...'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: 'And her ability to value everyone, no matter who they are, is indeed her most outstanding quality...'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Samantha is certainly the most forthcoming Homecoming Princess of the year.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'While initial poll results showed that nearly 60% of the student body believed she had no chance of becoming Queen, newer data suggests she now has a chance.'

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Sam's honesty and her promise to stand up to tyranny on behalf of all students should inspire all of us that we need to be true to ourselves...'
